discovery: Precision mapping of the cosmic microwave background anisotropies with WMAP, establishing the standard ΛCDM cosmological model

nominees.name: David N. Spergel
nominees.affiliation: Simons Foundation and Princeton University, USA

motivation: The Wilkinson Microwave Anisotropy Probe turned cosmology into a precision science. Bennett conceived and led the mission, Page led the design and calibration of its differential radiometers and the control of instrumental systematics, and Spergel led the theoretical interpretation and cosmological-parameter analysis. WMAP measured the temperature and polarization anisotropies of the microwave background over the full sky with unprecedented accuracy. From these data the age, geometry and composition of the Universe were determined to percent-level precision: a spatially flat universe dominated by dark energy and cold dark matter, with nearly scale-invariant, adiabatic, Gaussian primordial fluctuations, and early reionization detected through polarization. These results, independently confirmed by Planck, galaxy clustering and baryon acoustic oscillations, define the six-parameter ΛCDM model that is the reference against which all modern tests of fundamental physics in cosmology, including today's tensions, are made.
